alternatives.argument: This is an explicit definition, not a theorem. It fixes positive symbolic c, G and mu0, defines epsilon0, kappa and alpha, sets the same smooth two-form F to alpha F, and gives the inverse mass, charge, spin and optional magnetic-flux conversions. The units follow by substitution of the SI dimensions and epsilon0 mu0 c^2=1; no empirical numerical input or field equation is inferred.

For the defined quadratic tensor, contract with g inverse: the two field contractions cancel the one-quarter times the four-dimensional trace, so Q is trace-free. Quadratic homogeneity gives Q(g,alpha F)=alpha^2 Q(g,F); alpha^2=kappa/(2 mu0) therefore turns kappa/mu0 Q into 2Q(g,calF). Tracing G+Lambda g=2Q gives -S+4Lambda=0; substituting S=4Lambda gives Ric-Lambda g=2Q. Conversely, tracing that Ricci equation gives S=4Lambda and recovers the Einstein form.

For a smooth positive Omega on an oriented four-manifold, the Hodge multiplier on two-forms is Omega^0=1, while determinant homogeneity gives vol_(Omega^2 g)=Omega^4 vol_g. Thus dF is unchanged and i_(Omega^-4 j)vol_(Omega^2 g)=i_jvol_g, proving the sourced equation both ways. Direct index raising gives the lower quadratic tensor factor Omega^-2, the upper tensor factor Omega^-6, and the unit-observer contraction factor Omega^-4. The two inverse metrics in F_ab F^ab cancel the volume factor, so the quadratic integral is unchanged on the stated domains.

Put u=Omega^-1 dOmega. The product rule and d^2=0 give du=0, hence nabla_a u_b is symmetric for the torsion-free metric connection. The Christoffel formula yields C^a_bc=delta^a_b u_c+delta^a_c u_b-g_bc u^a. Substituting Gamma+C into the curvature definition and contracting gives derivative contribution -2H_ab-g_ab theta; expanding the two quadratic contractions gives 2u_a u_b-2g_ab s. Tracing yields S-tilde=Omega^-2(S-6theta-6s), and substituting into G-tilde=Ric-tilde-(1/2)S-tilde g-tilde gives the displayed Einstein tensor identity.

For constant lambda, the metric inverse scales lambda^-2 while metric derivatives scale lambda^2, so the Christoffel symbols and curvature operator are unchanged; Ricci lower is unchanged, scalar curvature scales lambda^-2, and G lower is unchanged. With F-prime=lambda F, one raised field slot scales lambda^-1, so both terms of Q lower are invariant; Lambda-prime g-prime=Lambda g. The conformal Maxwell theorem first maps (F,j) to (F,lambda^-4 j); linearity in (F,j) then multiplies both by lambda to obtain (lambda F,lambda^-3 j).

Linearity of d and the Hodge map keeps F-epsilon=epsilon F1 source-free. The defined electromagnetic tensor is quadratic, so its lower tensor is epsilon^2 T1. Substituting the assumed fixed vacuum Einstein equation gives the exact residual -kappa epsilon^2 T1. Smooth components are bounded on compact K, and homogeneity of the fixed chart component supremum norm gives the exact norm identity. If epsilon is nonzero and T1 is nonzero at a point, the residual is nonzero there; no nearby-solution estimate follows.

Minkowski has constant metric components, hence zero Christoffel, curvature and Einstein tensor; with F=j=Lambda=0 it solves the equations. For Omega=exp(k x^1), u=k dx^1, H=0, theta=0 and s=k^2. The conformal scalar-curvature formula gives S-tilde=-6 k^2 exp(-2 k x^1), nonzero. Maxwell remains satisfied at F=j=0. If the transformed Lambda-zero electrovac equation held, tracing G-tilde=0 would force S-tilde=0, contradiction.

From kappa=8 pi G/c^4 and epsilon0 mu0 c^2=1, alpha^2=4 pi G epsilon0/c^2. Positivity yields alpha/(4 pi epsilon0 c)=sqrt(G/(4 pi epsilon0 c^4)). Multiplying F_0r=-Q_e/(4 pi epsilon0 c r^2) by alpha therefore gives calF_0r=-q_geo/r^2 on r>0. The excluded origin is not assigned a source or distributional solution.
